alternatives.reason_rejected: .mcp.json is tracked in git; a machine-specific path breaks other contributors and beta testers

alternatives.option: Fix PATH at the cmux level (teammate spawn environment)
alternatives.reason_rejected: Upstream issue we don't control; worth reporting to cmux, but the repo needs a fix that works today

alternatives.option: Re-enable plugin's bundled MCP server as fallback for teammates
alternatives.reason_rejected: Would reintroduce the dual-server split-brain the beta enrollment deliberately eliminated via deniedMcpServers

context: cmux-spawned named teammates could not connect to twining; MCP log showed 'Connection failed after 8ms: Executable not found in $PATH: npx' for the teammate session while the main session and headless claude -p worked fine (they inherit the full user PATH).
rationale: sh -lc makes macOS run path_helper, which rebuilds PATH from /etc/paths.d (including homebrew), so npx resolves regardless of the spawning environment's PATH. Verified under the teammate's exact minimal PATH and end-to-end via a cmux-spawned teammate that connected in 859ms and posted successfully. `exec` keeps signal delivery (SIGINT/SIGTERM) going to the node process instead of the wrapper shell.
summary: Chose sh -lc login-shell wrapper in .mcp.json (`sh -lc "exec npx -y twining-mcp@next --project ."`) over absolute npx path, cmux-level PATH fix, or re-enabling the plugin's bundled server
